_comment: The one place for names and links. tools/build.py fills the {{...}} placeholders in src/ with these values; a value may use other placeholders. APP_NAME is the name in the Odoo Apps store: max 25 characters, no company name, no 'Odoo'. NAME_FINAL false makes tools/build.py release refuse to write the store branches. WEBSITE is still the company site: set it to the TimeViking Odoo landing page before publishing.
SUMMARY: Sync timesheets, projects, tasks and time off with {{PRODUCT_NAME}}, the fast timesheet app
AUTHOR: Software Services BV
